verses.original: אַל־ תִּשְׂמַ֨ח יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל׀ אֶל־ גִּיל֙ כָּֽעַמִּ֔ים כִּ֥י זָנִ֖יתָ מֵעַ֣ל אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ אָהַ֣בְתָּ אֶתְנָ֔ן עַ֖ל כָּל־ גָּרְנ֥וֹת דָּגָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiś·maḥ yiś·rā·’êl ’el- gîl kā·‘am·mîm kî zā·nî·ṯā mê·‘al ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’ā·haḇ·tā ’eṯ·nān ‘al kāl- gā·rə·nō·wṯ dā·ḡān
verses.literal: Do not rejoice O Israel with exultation like the nations for you have played the harlot against your God you have made love for hire on every threshing floor . . .

verses.original: גֹּ֥רֶן וָיֶ֖קֶב לֹ֣א יִרְעֵ֑ם וְתִיר֖וֹשׁ יְכַ֥חֶשׁ בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: gō·ren wā·ye·qeḇ lō yir·‘êm wə·ṯî·rō·wōš yə·ḵa·ḥeš bāh
verses.literal: The threshing floor and winepress will not feed them and the new wine will fail them

verses.original: לֹ֥א יֵשְׁב֖וּ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ יְהוָ֑ה וְשָׁ֤ב אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ מִצְרַ֔יִם וּבְאַשּׁ֖וּר טָמֵ֥א יֹאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lō yê·šə·ḇū bə·’e·reṣ Yah·weh wə·šāḇ ’ep̄·ra·yim miṣ·ra·yim ū·ḇə·’aš·šūr ṭā·mê yō·ḵê·lū
verses.literal: They will not remain in the land of the LORD Ephraim will return to Egypt and eat unclean food in Assyria

verses.original: לֹא־ יִסְּכ֨וּ לַיהוָ֥ה׀ יַיִן֮ וְלֹ֣א יֶֽעֶרְבוּ־ לוֹ֒ זִבְחֵיהֶ֗ם כְּלֶ֤חֶם אוֹנִים֙ לָהֶ֔ם כָּל־ אֹכְלָ֖יו יִטַמָּ֑אוּ כִּֽי־ לַחְמָ֣ם לְנַפְשָׁ֔ם לֹ֥א יָב֖וֹא בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lō- yis·sə·ḵū Yah·weh ya·yin wə·lō ye·‘er·ḇū- lōw ziḇ·ḥê·hem kə·le·ḥem ’ō·w·nîm lā·hem kāl- ’ō·ḵə·lāw yi·ṭam·må̄·ʾū kî- laḥ·mām lə·nap̄·šām lō yā·ḇō·w bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: They will not pour out wine offerings to the LORD and their sacrifices will not please Him but will be to them like the bread of mourners all who eat will be defiled For their bread will be for themselves it will not enter the house of the LORD

verses.original: מַֽה־ תַּעֲשׂ֖וּ לְי֣וֹם מוֹעֵ֑ד וּלְי֖וֹם חַג־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mah- ta·‘ă·śū lə·yō·wm mō·w·‘êḏ ū·lə·yō·wm ḥaḡ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: What will you do on the appointed day on the day of the LORD’s feast

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הִנֵּ֤ה הָֽלְכוּ֙ מִשֹּׁ֔ד מִצְרַ֥יִם תְּקַבְּצֵ֖ם מֹ֣ף תְּקַבְּרֵ֑ם מַחְמַ֣ד לְכַסְפָּ֗ם קִמּוֹשׂ֙ יִֽירָשֵׁ֔ם ח֖וֹחַ בְּאָהֳלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hin·nêh hā·lə·ḵū miš·šōḏ miṣ·ra·yim tə·qab·bə·ṣêm mōp̄ tə·qab·bə·rêm maḥ·maḏ lə·ḵas·pām qim·mō·wś yî·rā·šêm ḥō·w·aḥ bə·’ā·ho·lê·hem
verses.literal: For even if they flee destruction Egypt will gather them and Memphis will bury them Their precious silver will be taken over by thistles and thorns will overrun their tents

verses.original: בָּ֣אוּ׀ יְמֵ֣י הַפְּקֻדָּ֗ה בָּ֚אוּ יְמֵ֣י הַשִׁלֻּ֔ם יֵדְע֖וּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֱוִ֣יל הַנָּבִ֗יא מְשֻׁגָּע֙ אִ֣ישׁ הָר֔וּחַ עַ֚ל רֹ֣ב עֲוֺנְךָ֔ וְרַבָּ֖ה מַשְׂטֵמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bā·’ū yə·mê hap·pə·qud·dāh bā·’ū yə·mê ha·šil·lum yê·ḏə·‘ū yiś·rā·’êl ’ĕ·wîl han·nā·ḇî mə·šug·gā‘ ’îš hā·rū·aḥ ‘al rōḇ ‘ă·wō·nə·ḵā wə·rab·bāh maś·ṭê·māh
verses.literal: The days of punishment have come the days of retribution have arrived let Israel know it The prophet is called a fool and the inspired man insane because of the greatness of your iniquity . . . and hostility

verses.original: צֹפֶ֥ה אֶפְרַ֖יִם עִם־ אֱלֹהָ֑י נָבִ֞יא פַּ֤ח יָקוֹשׁ֙ עַל־ כָּל־ דְּרָכָ֔יו מַשְׂטֵמָ֖ה בְּבֵ֥ית אֱלֹהָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ṣō·p̄eh ’ep̄·ra·yim ‘im- ’ĕ·lō·hāy nā·ḇî paḥ yā·qō·wōš ‘al- kāl- də·rā·ḵāw maś·ṭê·māh bə·ḇêṯ ’ĕ·lō·hāw
verses.literal: The prophet is Ephraim’s watchman along with my God yet the snare of the fowler lies on all his paths Hostility is in the house of his God

verses.original: הֶעְמִֽיקוּ־ שִׁחֵ֖תוּ כִּימֵ֣י הַגִּבְעָ֑ה יִזְכּ֣וֹר עֲוֺנָ֔ם יִפְק֖וֹד חַטֹּאותָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: he‘·mî·qū- ši·ḥê·ṯū kî·mê hag·giḇ·‘āh yiz·kō·wr ‘ă·wō·nām yip̄·qō·wḏ ḥaṭ·ṭō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: They have deeply corrupted themselves as in the days of Gibeah He will remember their guilt He will punish their sins

verses.original: כַּעֲנָבִ֣ים בַּמִּדְבָּ֗ר מָצָ֙אתִי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כְּבִכּוּרָ֤ה בִתְאֵנָה֙ בְּרֵ֣אשִׁיתָ֔הּ רָאִ֖יתִי אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם הֵ֜מָּה בָּ֣אוּ בַֽעַל־ פְּע֗וֹר וַיִּנָּֽזְרוּ֙ לַבֹּ֔שֶׁת וַיִּהְי֥וּ שִׁקּוּצִ֖ים כְּאָהֳבָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ka·‘ă·nā·ḇîm bam·miḏ·bār mā·ṣā·ṯî yiś·rā·’êl kə·ḇik·kū·rāh ḇiṯ·’ê·nāh bə·rê·šî·ṯāh rā·’î·ṯî ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem hêm·māh bā·’ū ḇa·‘al- pə·‘ō·wr way·yin·nā·zə·rū lab·bō·šeṯ way·yih·yū šiq·qū·ṣîm kə·’ā·ho·ḇām
verses.literal: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness I saw your fathers as the firstfruits of the fig tree in its first season But they went to Baal-peor and consecrated themselves to Shame so they became as detestable as the thing they loved

verses.original: אֶפְרַ֕יִם כָּע֖וֹף יִתְעוֹפֵ֣ף כְּבוֹדָ֑ם מִלֵּדָ֥ה וּמִבֶּ֖טֶן וּמֵהֵרָיֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ’ep̄·ra·yim kā·‘ō·wp̄ yiṯ·‘ō·w·p̄êp̄ kə·ḇō·w·ḏām mil·lê·ḏāh ū·mib·be·ṭen ū·mê·hê·rā·yō·wn
verses.literal: Ephraim’s glory will fly away like a bird with no birth no pregnancy and no conception

verses.original: כִּ֤י אִם־ יְגַדְּלוּ֙ אֶת־ בְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וְשִׁכַּלְתִּ֖ים מֵֽאָדָ֑ם כִּֽי־ גַם־ א֥וֹי לָהֶ֖ם בְּשׂוּרִ֥י מֵהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- yə·ḡad·də·lū ’eṯ- bə·nê·hem wə·šik·kal·tîm mê·’ā·ḏām kî- ḡam- ’ō·w lā·hem bə·śū·rî mê·hem
verses.literal: Even if they raise their children I will bereave them of each one Yes . . . woe be to them when I turn away from them

verses.original: אֶפְרַ֛יִם כַּאֲשֶׁר־ רָאִ֥יתִי לְצ֖וֹר שְׁתוּלָ֣ה בְנָוֶ֑ה וְאֶפְרַ֕יִם לְהוֹצִ֥יא אֶל־ הֹרֵ֖ג בָּנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ’ep̄·ra·yim ka·’ă·šer- rā·’î·ṯî lə·ṣō·wr šə·ṯū·lāh ḇə·nā·weh wə·’ep̄·ra·yim lə·hō·w·ṣî ’el- hō·rêḡ bā·nāw
verses.literal: I have seen Ephraim like Tyre planted in a meadow But Ephraim will bring out his children for slaughter

verses.original: תֵּן־ לָהֶ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה מַה־ תִּתֵּ֑ן תֵּן־ לָהֶם֙ רֶ֣חֶם מַשְׁכִּ֔יל וְשָׁדַ֖יִם צֹמְקִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: tên- lā·hem Yah·weh mah- tit·tên tên- lā·hem re·ḥem maš·kîl wə·šā·ḏa·yim ṣō·mə·qîm
verses.literal: Give them O LORD what will You give Give them wombs that miscarry and breasts that dry up

verses.original: כָּל־ רָעָתָ֤ם בַּגִּלְגָּל֙ כִּֽי־ שָׁ֣ם שְׂנֵאתִ֔ים עַ֚ל רֹ֣עַ מַֽעַלְלֵיהֶ֔ם מִבֵּיתִ֖י אֲגָרְשֵׁ֑ם לֹ֤א אוֹסֵף֙ אַהֲבָתָ֔ם כָּל־ שָׂרֵיהֶ֖ם סֹרְרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- rā·‘ā·ṯām bag·gil·gāl kî- šām śə·nê·ṯîm ‘al rō·a‘ ma·‘al·lê·hem mib·bê·ṯî ’ă·ḡā·rə·šêm lō ’ō·w·sêp̄ ’a·hă·ḇā·ṯām kāl- śā·rê·hem sō·rə·rîm
verses.literal: All their evil appears at Gilgal for there I hated them I will drive them from My house for the wickedness of their deeds I will no longer love them all their leaders are rebellious

verses.original: הֻכָּ֣ה אֶפְרַ֔יִם שָׁרְשָׁ֥ם יָבֵ֖שׁ פְּרִ֣י בְלִי יַעֲשׂ֑וּן גַּ֚ם כִּ֣י יֵֽלֵד֔וּן וְהֵמַתִּ֖י מַחֲמַדֵּ֥י בִטְנָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: huk·kāh ’ep̄·ra·yim šā·rə·šām yā·ḇêš pə·rî ḇə·lī ya·‘ă·śūn gam kî yê·lê·ḏūn wə·hê·mat·tî ma·ḥă·mad·dê ḇiṭ·nām
verses.literal: Ephraim is struck down their root is withered they cannot bear fruit . . . Even if they bear children I will slay the darlings of their wombs

verses.original: יִמְאָסֵ֣ם אֱלֹהַ֔י כִּ֛י לֹ֥א שָׁמְע֖וּ ל֑וֹ וְיִהְי֥וּ נֹדְדִ֖ים בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: yim·’ā·sêm ’ĕ·lō·hay kî lō šā·mə·‘ū lōw wə·yih·yū nō·ḏə·ḏîm bag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: My God will reject them because they have not obeyed Him and they shall be wanderers among the nations
